subject: GloVe
source_sentence: Here, vw is the word embedding obtained from GloVe or contextualized word embeddings from ELMo, vp is a randomly initialized and trainable embedding of the part-of-speech tag, and vt corresponds to the timex embedding derived for time expressions (explained in Section 2.1).
title: Embedding time expressions for deep temporal ordering models

subject: ELMo
source_sentence: Here, vw is the word embedding obtained from GloVe or contextualized word embeddings from ELMo, vp is a randomly initialized and trainable embedding of the part-of-speech tag, and vt corresponds to the timex embedding derived for time expressions (explained in Section 2.1).
title: Embedding time expressions for deep temporal ordering models

subject: BiLSTM
source_sentence: Contextual Encoding A biLSTM is used to obtain contextualized embeddings hk for each token xk in the two sentences, as shown in Figure 1.
title: Embedding time expressions for deep temporal ordering models

subject: Dependency Parser
source_sentence: Dependency Encoding We use the Stanford Dependency Parser to extract the dependency paths for both events to their lowest common ancestor.
title: Embedding time expressions for deep temporal ordering models

subject: Experiments
source_sentence: Through experiments on two datasets, we show that incorporating these embeddings in deep temporal models leads to an improvement in the overall temporal classification performance.
